comparisons.name: gain-light-masked
comparisons.description: As gain-light with the symbol, the name, the price and the text of the badge masked, which are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms: scores the badge, the hairline and the sparkline. The sparkline is not masked: its series is the line of the screenshot, traced, so what is left along the line is the error of the tracing.
